22:["$","p",null,{"children":["Sensing fails differently from moving. Wheel slip is a small perturbation of a mostly-correct\nanswer, which is why one Gaussian per motion leg is a defensible model. A LiDAR beam does not\nperturb — it ",["$","em",null,{"children":"switches"}],". It either measures the wall the map predicts, or it measures the person\nstanding in front of the wall, or it measures nothing at all because the wall was black felt, or it\nreturns a number that came from a neighbouring transducer's echo. Four categorically different\nthings happen, and a model that averages them is a model of nothing."]}]
